scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')){fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','dist',{recursive:true});}"
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build --prefix frontend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')){fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','dist',{recursive:true});}"
